subject: OpenCare OSS integration surcharge, amortization options & evidence delivery
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@opencare.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Miles <j.miles@opencare.health>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on OSS integration surcharge + evidence timeline

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising for our triage workflows. We're working through procurement and have a couple of follow-ups specific to the compliance add-ons: audit logs, KMS/HSM, and the EU data residency requirement for a small pilot.

Primary asks:
- Can you itemize the HSM costs versus managed KMS (we have an on-prem HSM appliance we may want to register with Redwood). Is that charged as a pass-through hardware surcharge or as a recurring "HSM seat" line item?
- If the HSM is pass-through (vendor-supplied), can Redwood amortize the hardware surcharge over a 12-month term on the invoice?
- We need a delivery plan for compliance evidence (SOC2 attestation excerpt, auditlog export tooling, KMS key-rotation proof). What does evidence delivery look like and how long after contract signature?

Other context: our legal team is sensitive to third-party hardware appearing on the contract as a capital expense; they prefer amortization or a monthly charge. Also important: we use a few OSS connectors that require a small integration surcharge per connector — how you classify that will impact our purchase order.

Can you share a breakdown and a recommended packaging option for a 12-month pilot (pilot size: ~100k tokens/day, EU residency enabled for pilot data subset)? We'd like a clean PO-friendly invoice line items list.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call if easier.

Best,
Samantha Reed
Head of Platform Partnerships
OpenCare Health

Attachments: none

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@opencare.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on OSS integration surcharge + evidence timeline

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then an attached proposal with line-itemization.

High-level options (we'll include numbers in the attached sheets):
1) Pass-through HSM hardware: listed as a one-time capital line on the invoice (vendor cost + 10% handling). We can offer an amortization schedule to spread that one-time cost over 12 months on your monthly invoices (we prepare an amortization CSV for your AP team).
2) Managed HSM (Redwood-provisioned HSM seats): recurring monthly line per HSM logical seat, includes monitoring and key rotation. Lower upfront, higher monthly.
3) Hybrid: one-time registration/setup fee + lower monthly seat.

OSS integration surcharge: we classify most small connector work as an "integration surcharge" (one-time professional-services-like line) unless it requires ongoing maintenance, in which case we move it to a small monthly support charge. For PO simplicity we can present it as either a one-time implementation fee (recommended) or amortize it over the pilot term.

Evidence delivery timeline:
- SOC2 excerpt and attestation: available immediately upon signature (we include our attestation excerpt and mapping).
- Auditlog exports: we can hand over a complete export within 7 business days of onboarding, and we provide ongoing self-service exports.
- KMS/HSM key rotation and attestation: if using Redwood-managed keys, rotation proofs are provided in our audit bundle within 3 business days of request. For customer-managed HSM (your appliance), we require coordination with your infra to certify registration — typical turnaround is 10–15 business days for validation and test keys.

I've attached: opencare-evidence-checklist.pdf, hsm-pricing-sheet.xlsx, and a proposed-amortization-schedule.csv that shows the 12-month spread. Numbers are ballpark for discussion; Ben and Aditya are looped to confirm technical/ops constraints.

Next steps:
- We'll prepare a PO-friendly invoice layout with the amortization rows and a short note describing "pass-through hardware amortized over 12 months".
- If your legal prefers, we can present the amortization as a monthly credit on the Redwood subscription line rather than a separate amortization document.

Would you like us to include a 1-month pilot credit if you sign within the next 2 weeks?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: opencare-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 42 KB), hsm-pricing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 14 KB), proposed-amortization-schedule.csv (csv, 2 KB)

From: Jordan Miles <j.miles@opencare.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@opencare.health>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on OSS integration surcharge + evidence timeline

Thanks, Evelyn — helpful breakdown. A couple of clarifying points from procurement/legal:

- Will Redwood accept an amortized hardware line that is visible on our PO as "HSM appliance pass-through (amortized)" with a monthly dollar value and a net-12 term? We want to avoid capitalizing a single vendor invoice.
- If we go with our appliance (customer-owned HSM), is there any recurring "registration" fee after the first 12 months? Our finance team wants to model ongoing OpEx.
- Can you confirm whether the OSS connector surcharge will be coded as an implementation item (so our SOW/PO maps it to CAPEX) or a subscription add-on (OpEx) — legal will decide based on classification.

Also, small ask: because our initial pilot will route EU-resident PII to your EU region, can Redwood guarantee that auditlog exports for that subset are segregated and delivered on a separate CSV? We need a clean separation for our auditors.

If these are nailed down, we're ready to move to signature. Could you circulate a final PO-friendly line item list (one page) and a DocuSign package?

— Jordan

Quoted below:
> On Wed, Sep 30, 2026 at 11:04 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then an attached proposal with line-itemization.

> > [snip attachments & options]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <j.miles@opencare.health>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@opencare.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on OSS integration surcharge + evidence timeline

Jordan / Samantha — quick confirmation and next steps.

1) Amortized HSM pass-through: Yes, we can present the HSM cost on the PO as "HSM appliance pass-through (amortized)" with a monthly line and net-12. We'll include a short note in the invoice: "hardware cost amortized over 12 months; full ownership with purchaser".

2) Registration fee post-12 months: For a customer-owned HSM we do not auto-charge a registration fee after the initial validation unless you request ongoing managed monitoring (optional). We'll put a clause that ongoing registration support is optional and billable.

3) OSS connector surcharge: We will mark the initial connector work as an implementation fee (one-time) in the base proposal. If OpenCare prefers OpEx classification, we can alternatively invoice it as a small recurring support add-on — we'll reflect both options on the one-page PO layout for legal to choose.

4) EU auditlog segregation: Confirmed. We will provide a separate CSV export for EU-resident PII auditlogs and tag exports with region metadata. Delivery: first export within 7 business days of onboarding, ongoing self-service thereafter.

Pilot credit: We can offer a 10% pilot credit on the platform subscription for the 1st month if signed within 10 business days.

I've updated the attached PO layout to reflect the amortization rows and both calendar and AP-friendly presentation. I'll open a DocuSign envelope (link below) with the commercial SOW and invoice appendix; Ben will confirm the HSM technical test plan and Aditya will validate the EU export for PII segregation (Ben/Aditya: please call out any red flags in the ticket).

DocuSign (will populate when envelope sent): https://www.docusign.com/link/abcdef123456
Jira procurement ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-8291

Next steps for us: Ben to create the HSM registration checklist ticket; Aditya to spin up an EU-export test plan. Expect a DocuSign envelope within 24 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this pilot started.

Best,
Evelyn
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): opencare-evidence-checklist.pdf, hsm-pricing-sheet.xlsx, proposed-amortization-schedule.csv
